description: This file defines an interface `AuthAttributeBagInterface` in the OrangeHRM authentication module, specifying methods for handling key-value pairs related to authentication attributes.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all stored attributes as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of stored attributes.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces current attributes with provided array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates attributes with provided array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, or default if not present.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified key.
